title: On Sending the letter by the morning coach
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：send　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 send 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the keeper ① sent the letter by the morning coach in silence, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② sends the letter by the morning coach twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ send the letter by the morning coach at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sent the letter by the morning coach before — a line in the register for March 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sending the letter by the morning coach in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ send word to every house before noon twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Send word to every house before noon at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ sends word to every house before noon in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sent the letter by the morning coach again when nobody else would.

⑩ To send the letter by the morning coach, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody sends the letter by the morning coach twice over again and somebody must send the letter by the morning coach in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 寄出（一般过去式 sent the letter by the morning coach：1986 年饲养员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 寄出（一般现在 sends the letter by the morning coach：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 寄出（不定式 to send the letter by the morning coach：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 寄出（过去完成时 had sent the letter by the morning coach：1980 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 寄出（动名词 sending the letter by the morning coach 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 派遣（send word to every house before noon：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去派遣午前给每户都捎了口信）
G. v. 派遣（send word to every house before noon：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 寄出（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 sends word to every house before noon，而母亲又一次 sent the letter by the morning coach）

answers.why: send 意为“寄出”，1986 年饲养员一言不发地寄出搭早班车把信寄走，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sent。
send 意为“寄出”，自那以后饲养员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sends。
send 意为“寄出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯寄出搭早班车把信寄走”，此处为不定式 to send the letter by the morning coach。
send 意为“寄出”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人寄出过，故用过去完成时 had sent。
send 意为“寄出”，饲养员说“寄出搭早班车把信寄走这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sending the letter by the morning coach 作主语。
send 意为“派遣”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去派遣午前给每户都捎了口信”，should ever 之后用原形 send word to every house before noon。
send 意为“派遣”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻派遣午前给每户都捎了口信（send word to every house before noon at once），以后再也不要提起。
send 意为“寄出”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例派遣午前给每户都捎了口信，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sends。
send 意为“寄出”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地寄出搭早班车把信寄走，用一般过去式 sent 叙述。
send 意为“寄出”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要寄出搭早班车把信寄走，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 send 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the keeper sent the letter by the morning coach in silence, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper sends the letter by the morning coach twice over whenever the zoo asks.
Sending the letter by the morning coach in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever send word to every house before noon twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo sends word to every house before noon in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sent the letter by the morning coach again, and the zoo remembered that half.
